title: What Lurks
description: A spooky modpack with minimal gore, but all the uneasiness. Do you dare look at what is around the corner?
body:
![This world isn't so kind to new adventurers...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c683fc85597b74d889aa063b4c38e9f07397bc80_0.webp)

Be careful of what lurks in the shadows....it leaves you restless...and the night isn't much better. 

This is a small horror modpack I made for my friends and wanted to share as we approach spooky season. There is very little gore, but it will still leave you uneasy as you walk through the forests.


Note:The biomes have been hand-picked to add the desired ambience, and the use of the shaders+resource packs accompanying this pack is HIGHLY encouraged.
